# sauth_outlet (Resource)

The outlet records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) app id
- `config` (Attributes) outlet config: url for slack, teams and webhook, secret for webhook, list_id for email (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `kind` (String) Delivery channel
- `name` (String) Display name

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether notices reach the outlet, default true

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `list_id` (String)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `url` (String)
